Self.Wiki: Sound region (the game's CSMsbPointSoundRegion). Overrides map sound settings while the listener is inside it. The game picks the active region separately for each field, and a field only counts when it is not -1 and the region's shape is a Box.

UnkT00.Wiki: A sound override read as a signed byte (255 = none). Retail uses 3-8, the same range as MapDefaultInfoParam ReverbDefaultType, so it is probably a reverb type override.

UnkT01.Wiki: Together with Unknown: 0x2 it groups regions in the sound-region manager; a value above 0 also sets a flag of its own. Retail 0/1/2.

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: Overrides the outdoor/indoor sound mode, like Collision Outdoor/Indoor Type: 0 outdoor, 1 half indoor, 2 indoor (Wwise OutdoorIndoor states). 255: no override.

WwiseEnvPlaceTypeID.Wiki: The Wwise environment place type used inside the region. -1: no override.

UnkT08.Wiki: A sound place override (-1 = none). The sound update uses it instead of its own value and looks it up in a param. Retail values are all WwiseEnvPlaceType values.

CommonPlaceType.Wiki: The common place type used inside the region (-1 = none). The sound update switches to it after a 2-second delay.

UnkT0C.Wiki: A flag (255 = none) that is only read in DLC (m61) maps. Retail: 1 on ten regions.
